The following events took place in '''37,453 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]] monks of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] discover a half-buried pyramidal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] they christen the "[[Tho Yor]]." The monks start attending the Tho Yor through [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]].<ref name="Date">In [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]], it is said that the Bendu monks attended the Tho Yor for a millennium before they finally heard its call, which occurred in [[36,453 BBY]] according to [[John Ostrander]].</ref>
